input.resize: bilinear, anti-aliased, to 224x224 (tf.image.resize antialias=True in training)

output.meaning: sigmoid score for DR present, in [0, 1]

threshold_source: highest validation threshold with sensitivity >= 0.85; the test split was not used for any choice
architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet) fine-tuned from block_13_expand; head GAP-Dropout(0.3)-Dense(64)-Dropout(0.2)-Dense(1, sigmoid); class weights; early stopping on validation AUC; seed 42

training.dataset: Kaggle ascanipek/eyepacs-aptos-messidor-diabetic-retinopathy (EyePACS + APTOS 2019 + Messidor-2 redistribution, pre-augmented, no patient identifiers)
training.split: by image group (augmentation suffixes stripped), stratified, seed 42: train 165,319 / validation 35,425 / test 35,426
training.licence_note: Underlying data is for non-commercial / academic use; no images are stored in this repository.

metrics_status: held-out test split by image (no patient IDs available; near-duplicates could not be excluded); not external validation; not clinically validated; 35,426 test images; meets the 85% sensitivity target; below the 80% specificity target
limitations: Screening support only. Not a diagnosis and not clinically validated.
Specificity 0.748 is below the 80% target: 25% of eyes without DR are flagged for specialist review.

The notebook found 236,170 image groups for 236,170 images: augmented copies and the two eyes of one patient could not be grouped, so near-duplicates may sit in both train and test and these figures may be optimistic.
No external evaluation; images from low-cost smartphone fundus lenses were never tested.
The 1-5 severity band is estimated from a binary score by a configurable policy; it is not an ICDR grade.
